typography.instructions: Use Chivo for all headings with tracking-tight. Use IBM Plex Sans for body text and UI elements. Use IBM Plex Mono for numerical data and metrics to give a precise engineering feel.
typography.font_install_command: Include Google Fonts link for Chivo, IBM Plex Sans, and IBM Plex Mono.

colors.instructions: Adopt the 'Performance Pro / Swiss High-Contrast' hybrid archetype. Use deep obsidian/slate for the background to represent cold/high-altitude. Primary is solar orange (heat/solar energy), secondary is ice blue (ambient temperature). Accent is thermal red (heat loss warnings). Never use pure white or pure black; tint greys with cool blue.

visual_enhancers.surface_strategy: Glassmorphism (The 'Crystal' Variant) adapted for dark mode. High opacity for readability (bg-black/60 or bg-[#0A0A0A]/70) with backdrop-blur-xl and a delicate 1px border-white/10. Do not use fully transparent backgrounds. This allows the mountain background to provide context without compromising dashboard legibility.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient diffuse shadows for floating elements.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for precise, technical iconography.

motion.background_animation: To fulfill 'highly animated with ladakh mounts', use an absolute positioned background layer featuring the Ladakh mountain image. Apply Framer Motion for a slow, continuous scale and pan (Ken Burns effect). Overlay this with 'react-tsparticles' simulating a gentle snowfall or floating solar particles to create an immersive, dynamic environment.
motion.ui_animation: Staggered entrance animations for dashboard widgets using Framer Motion. Smooth state transitions on hover (e.g., -translate-y-1, shadow glow).

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_layout: High Density Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel must be utilized with logical flow.
grids_and_layouts.spacing_philosophy: Generous spacing within cards (p-6). Data-dense but clean. Follow optical alignment.

components.name: Simulation Controls Panel
components.description: Sidebar or top section for user-defined shelter dimensions, orientation, openings, materials, thermal mass, and simulation duration. Use Shadcn forms, Select, and Sliders.

components.name: Thermal vs Ambient Chart
components.description: Main area line chart (Recharts) showing inside temperature vs ambient temperature over time.
components.style: Grid area span 2 or 3. Dark background with vibrant orange (inside) and icy blue (ambient) lines.

components.name: Heat Flow Analysis
components.description: Bar or Radar chart showing heat flow/losses by envelope and openings.
components.style: Use Recharts. Minimal grid lines, tooltips with IBM Plex Mono.

components.name: Efficiency Recommendation Engine
components.description: A dedicated card highlighting the most thermally efficient scenario (Material combination).
components.style: Highlight with a subtle Tracing Beam or animated glowing border to draw attention.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure data visualizations use color-blind-friendly palettes (e.g., distinct orange and blue). Normal text minimum 4.5:1 ratio against backgrounds.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid.

background_mountains.description: Snow covered mountain under blue sky during daytime. Use this as the base layer for the animated background, styled with dark overlays (e.g., bg-black/80) to maintain high contrast for the UI.

architecture_reference.description: Contemporary sustainable building. Use for material scenario thumbnails or recommendation cards.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for widgets over the animated mountain background.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js
Provide design guidelines for .js files, NOT .tsx files. Ensure Shadcn installations and component setups are tailored for plain JavaScript.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background.
